- Uptime: 99.95% standard; 99.99% optional for Enterprise with documented multi-region failover and monthly architecture review.
- Service credits: tiered sliding scale by monthly uptime (example in doc) capped at 50% of monthly service fees for the month of outage; credits not refundable cash.
- Response times: P1 targeting 1 hour initial response, 4 hour action plan; P2 4 hour response; definitions in annex.
- Maintenance: standard weekly 4-hour window; enterprise carveouts: 2x 3-hour blackout windows per quarter for client-critical work; scheduled >72 hours notice.

Recommend we propose a short canary clause: Redwood will provide a runbook and postmortem for any outage >30 minutes that would otherwise trigger credits.
